papers.title: Study on the influence of process parameters on the clearance feature in non-assembly mechanism manufactured by selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: Faculty of Mechanical Engineering & Mechanics, Ningbo University, Ningbo, Zhejiang, 315211, China

corresponding_authors.name: Yang Liu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Faculty of Mechanical Engineering & Mechanics, Ningbo University, Ningbo, Zhejiang, 315211, China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究SLM工艺参数对非装配机构间隙的影响，与生物医学植入物的应力屏蔽、多孔结构或骨整合无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on manufacturing clearance in non-assembly mechanisms via SLM, with no biomedical context, no stress shielding consideration, no porous structure design, and no mechanical testing for implant applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM工艺参数对非装配机构间隙特征的影响
summary_zh.method: 通过实验设计改变激光功率、扫描速度等参数，测量间隙尺寸
summary_zh.result: 发现参数组合对间隙精度有显著影响，可优化实现所需间隙
summary_zh.validation: 采用实测间隙值与设计值对比验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate how selective laser melting process parameters affect the clearance in non-assembly mechanisms.
summary_en.method: Experimental design varying laser power, scan speed, and other parameters; clearance measured and analyzed.
summary_en.result: Process parameters significantly influence clearance accuracy; optimal parameter sets can achieve desired clearance.
summary_en.validation: Comparison of measured clearance with designed target values.
